verdict.rationale: BigQuery's own access-control docs list predefined IAM roles and permissions that apply at the dataset, table, view, and routine level. That supports least-privilege scoping of whatever identity an agent uses. The pack does not show how scoped credentials (service accounts or keys) are actually issued, nor any agent-specific credential guidance. Missing for 10: documented credential issuance flow (service account/key or token creation), agent-specific scoped-credential guidance, short-lived/expiring tokens, independent or hands-on corroboration.
